backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, time zones, habit data, and access control with quote storage and day calculations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing quote-related frontend files, components, and test IDs for two features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short descriptions of multiple frontend files for reference and build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables, light/dark themes, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app via root div and main.tsx module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app wiring React Query, header, daily quote banner, habit view, footer, and toaster notifications.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthRequire: Alert component prompting the user to sign in with an embedded login button.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthStateIn: Badge showing whether the user is signed in based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button handling login/logout flows using Internet Identity and clearing React Query cache.
frontend/src/components/quotes/DailyMoti: Displays the daily quote with loading skeleton and fallback message using useDailyZenQuote.
frontend/src/components/quotes/TimeZoneI: Empty file placeholder for time zone prompt component.
frontend/src/features/becoming/api/queri: React Query hooks for managing habits with actor initialization handling, error normalization, and optimistic updates.
frontend/src/features/becoming/component: Main habits page that handles authentication, data fetching states, and renders habit manager, charts, summaries, and the habit grid.
Shows an error alert with a user-friendly message and an optional retry button.
Displays loading skeletons for the habit grid, month tabs, and habit rows.
Modal for editing a habit’s name, unit type, and monthly volume with validation and mutation calls.
Renders the habit grid with day headers and rows for each habit or a placeholder if none exist.
Defines layout constants and helper functions for consistent habit grid column sizing. Generates CSS grid column templates and shared day column classes.
Provides UI to add new habits with inline input and mutation handling.
Renders a habit row with editable info, daily completion checkboxes, and a popover for actions.
Popover wrapping a habit row that exposes an edit action.
Aggregates and displays total reps and time for the selected month across habits.
Month selector component using tab triggers for switching the displayed month.
Renders a yearly bar chart for four specific habits using aggregated monthly totals and a custom tooltip. Skips rendering if none of the tracked habits are present.
frontend/src/features/becoming/constants: Provides static month data for 2026 and helpers to retrieve month info and day counts. Used for scheduling and calendar-based components.
frontend/src/features/becoming/state/hab: Defines habit completion and volume helpers including completion maps, volume formatting, and monthly aggregation. Supports both time and numeric volume units.
frontend/src/features/becoming/utils/tim: Implements parsing, validation, normalization, and formatting utilities for time strings in minutes/seconds. Converts between formats and computes totals safely.
frontend/src/features/quotes/hooks/useDa: Fetches the authenticated user's daily quote and auto-refetches at the next 8am UK time. Parses quote strings and manages loading and error states.
frontend/src/features/quotes/utils/ukQuo: Computes milliseconds until the next 8am UK time accounting for timezone changes. Adds a buffer to avoid early rollover.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an actor tied to the user's identity, initializing access control when authenticated. Invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithTimeout.t: Creates an actor with a 15s timeout and normalized error handling, with manual retry support. Invalidates dependent queries on successful initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for handling Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and stored identity restoration.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind-based styling, color variables, glass effects, and touch optimizations for the app's visual theme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and the Internet Identity provider before rendering.
frontend/src/utils/icErrors.ts: Utility functions for normalizing errors and detecting stopped-canister errors, returning safe user-friendly messages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, color mappings to CSS variables, fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project requirements, known issues, and pending feature requests for daily quote rotation at 8am UK time.
